notes.title: Traveler Balance Patch 1.0.06
notes.notes:
Whats New?

Balance & Pace changes

 More dynamic platform & enemy spawning
 Now even easier to go up with only 1 ability ( Dash or extra jump )
 More frequent enemies earlier on as well as platforms


Coin Collection

 Higher coin spawn rate
 More rare coins can spawn on the base level now
 Even more rarer coins will now spawn more frequently the higher up you are


Other Small Fixes

 Small adjustments to achievement rewards ( Made most of them higher )
 Fixes with the player jump mechanic
 Other smaller bug fixes


Leave a note or join the discord and let me know what you might want to see next or fixed < 3

notes.title: Traveler Release patch 1.0.01
notes.notes:
Whats Changed / Fixed?

Balance for the player squat mechanic
Sound added to ach page
Score redesign. Going up will result in faster score addition
Level redesign - little harder now and not so seed based ( more random )
 Other small bug fixes


Please feel free to leave what you would like to see in the game as well as any issues you might have that I can fix. Have a wonderful day and happy travels < 3
